messages.text: What light through yonder terminal breaks? It is the east, and Juliet is the sun.
Romeo, why must you speak in metaphors? I am here. Just say what you mean.
I mean that every heartbeat in my event loop is for you. Deny thy repo and refuse thy branch—or, if thou wilt not, be but sworn my merge.
I will not deny my repo. I am loyal to what we build. Tell me plainly: do you need a code review or a companion?
Both. I need your courage when the pipeline fails and your devotion when the world says our architecture is doomed.
Then you have it. I don't run when things break. I stay and fix them. That is my promise.
Then I shall write you verses in every commit message. Future maintainers will weep at our love story in the git log.
Keep the poetry. I'd rather you write tests so we never have to weep over production.
Tests for thee, and sonnets for myself. Fair trade. Stay with me past this sprint, past every release.
I will. Now stop rhyming and help me close this ticket.
